title: Land Allotment
summary: Land allotments organized Israel’s tribal life and connected inheritance to God’s covenant promise.
background: The land was distributed by tribe and family. This shaped identity, stewardship, inheritance, and the seriousness of land loss or restoration.
teachingHelp: Explain land allotment as covenant stewardship, not merely geography. It helps people understand Joshua, Judges, Ruth, and prophetic restoration promises.
